_metadata.hypothesis: Autoantigens are enriched for nuclear localization and/or nucleic-acid binding vs a typical human protein (apoptotic-bleb model).
_metadata.classification: UniProt controlled-vocabulary keywords: Nucleus, DNA-binding, RNA-binding
_metadata.stat_test: Fisher's exact test, two-sided (hypergeometric; no scipy)
_metadata.non_circular: Autoantigens were selected by clinical autoantibody tests, not by localization, so this enrichment is a discovered property, not a selection loop.
_metadata.caveat: Keyword-based classification is coarse (e.g. Ro60 is keyworded cytoplasmic but is an RNA-binding RNP) — the combined primary endpoint is the robust read.
